claims: Rapper Offset was shot on Monday, April 6, 2026, near the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Hollywood, Florida.
Rapper Offset was hospitalized in stable condition.
Offset's representative confirmed Offset was receiving medical care for non-life-threatening injuries.
The incident occurred in the valet area of the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood in Florida.
Offset is stable and closely monitored, according to a spokesperson.
The Seminole Police Department confirmed an incident occurred.
The Seminole Police Department confirmed one person was taken to Memorial Regional Hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
The Seminole Police Department did not initially name the victim.
